newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-April state retail sales up 5.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-April state retail sales up 5.7 pct.

text.p: China's state sector retail sales of consumer goods hit 224.83 billion yuan ($27 billion) in the first four months, up 5.7 percent from the same year-ago period, the China Business Daily said on Monday.
Retail sales of consumer goods by collective firms rose 10.8 percent year-on-year to 159.38 billion yuan in the first four months, it said.
Retail sales by private sector firms hit 483.58 billion yuan in the January to April period, the newspaper said, but did not give comparative figures.
A survey of 100 big state-owned retail firms showed their combined profits were down by 2.6 percent in the first four months compared with the year-ago period, the newspaper said.
